invariants: GREEN CANDIDATE MEANS PROMOTE TO PRODUCTION

registeredObligations.expected: Every optional Make scenario and Brain agent remains inside the shared 10000-credit monthly envelope.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Current budget envelope, period usage, remaining credits and run decision are present in the canonical cost projection.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Defer optional work, preserve protected interrupts and re-evaluate after the next verified cost snapshot.

registeredObligations.expected: Every discovered Make scenario and registered Brain agent is classified and represented in the daily normalized cost ledger.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: The catalog contains every current inventory key once and unknown optional components are BUDGET_DEFERRED.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Refresh inventory, deduplicate by component key and quarantine invalid or contradictory metering.

registeredObligations.expected: Every daily BG159 fleet inventory refresh produces exactly one governed portfolio decision: SAFE_OPTIMIZATION_CANDIDATE, VERIFIED_NO_ACTION, or BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY, with cost/outcome evidence and shared-current-state visibility.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: The daily decision records SAFE_OPTIMIZATION_CANDIDATE, VERIFIED_NO_ACTION, or BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY with inventory fingerprint, cost/outcome evidence and BG167 visibility for every material change.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Refresh the inventory, reuse known fingerprints, deduplicate the candidate and decision, verify no duplicate external side effect exists, and resume recovery until the portfolio outcome is verified or a valid hard boundary remains.

registeredObligations.expected: Every material budget decision and verified optimization outcome is routed through BG168 and visible in BG167.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: brain.v1 event includes trace, correlation, fingerprint, evidence and protected metrics; BG167 confirms visibility.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Retry routing at most twice per hypothesis, then retain locally verified evidence and resume through the shared-memory recovery path.

registeredObligations.expected: The cost dashboard and API remain private, read-only and fail closed for anonymous or unauthorized users.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Anonymous receives 401, wrong role receives 403, authorized app_metadata role receives sanitized aggregate data only.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Block access and rollback the candidate if authorization, no-store, CSP, noindex or data-minimization checks fail.

registeredObligations.expected: The dashboard uses the newest verified canonical BG159 or strongly consistent projection without exposing raw prompts, CRM payloads or secrets.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Projection exposes source timestamp and fingerprint and selects the newest valid aggregate source.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Keep the last verified projection, mark freshness visibly and reject malformed or untrusted records.

registeredObligations.expected: A green dashboard candidate is promoted only through BG169 and verified on the exact production SHA.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Exact candidate SHA, CI, production deploy identity, anonymous-denial smoke and protected regression checks are green.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Rollback to the last-known-good production tree when an exact-SHA or protected-metric check regresses.
